info.title: Alchemist
info.description: Generate placeholder unit tests for .NET solutions with a command line interface that supports multiple unit testing frameworks.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generate placeholder unit tests for a C# solution into a dedicated project.

options.name: --framework
options.description: Unit testing framework for generated unit test files and UnitTests.csproj. Defaults to xUnit.

options.name: --regeneration.mode
options.description: How to handle existing unit test files: Skip adds missing unit tests. Update refreshes unit tests and adds new ones. And replace overwrites files. Defaults to Skip.

options.name: --regeneration.labels
options.description: Whether to output UnitTestID labels in generated unit tests. Use '--regeneration.labels false' to disable. Defaults to true.
